_comment: Default energy model for the simulator's battery panel, used when hardware/power/model.json is absent. When it exists, build.sh copies it to power-model.json and the page converts it (typical values, 'normal' profile) the same way hardware/power/power.py reads it. A 'use' here is 70 s awake: the firmware's 60 s idle time-out plus ~10 s of interaction.
